Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-cantos-de-la-visera-ii-abrigo-del.story: From Montealegre del Castillo it runs 189 km to Montealegre del Castillo; allow about 3 h 16 of riding. It goes by way of Cueva del Peliciego, Abrigo de los Cortijos, Abrigo del Paso and back through Abrigo de los Cortijos. The highest point is about 800 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
